case_name: Smt. Rekha W/O. Ningappa Kolala vs Sri. Ningappa S/O. Shivalingappa ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Rekha W/O. Ningappa Kolala (wife, homemaker)
parties.respondent_defendant: Sri. Ningappa S/O. Shivalingappa Kolala (husband, bill collector/agriculture)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2013. Two children were born, one of whom died within 15 days. Petitioner was subjected to physical and mental harassment, driven out of the matrimonial home, and initiated proceedings under Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case must demonstrate sufficient reasons for the same.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to show that there are sufficient reasons for transferring the case from one court to another.

legal_principles.principle: A party's financial inability and physical inconvenience can be sufficient reason for transferring a case.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner's financial inability and the physical inconvenience to travel along with leaving behind the child would cause much hardship upon her.

legal_principles.principle: A party's apprehension of serious threat to their life can be a sufficient reason for transferring a case.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner apprehends the serious threat to her life in the event of her visiting to the place of the matrimonial home to contest the divorce proceedings.

outcome.final_order: Petition seeking transfer of M.C.No.72/2021 pending on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Shiggaon to the Civil Judge and Principal JMFC Court, Mundagod.
